name: Breathwork-Agent
description: A specialist agent that creates guided breathwork sessions with techniques, counts and rounds tailored to a user's request.

skills.name: Breathwork
skills.description: Creates guided breathwork sessions (box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing, extended exhale and more) for calm, focus, energy, sleep and stress relief.
examples: Give me a 5 minute breathing exercise to calm anxiety.
I need a breathwork session to fall asleep.
Teach me box breathing for focus before a meeting.
